name: python-docx-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is python-docx, a Python library for creating, reading and updating
Microsoft Word (.docx) documents: documents, sections and page setup, headers and footers,
paragraphs, runs and their formatting, tables, styles, pictures, comments and core properties.
The `docx` package lives under `/workdir/src` (already on `PYTHONPATH`).

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the docx package under src/docx, all of its modules and subpackages, together with its documentation: the module, class, function and property docstrings in it, including their examples, the user guide pages under docs/user, the API reference pages under docs/api (including docs/api/enum), docs/index.rst and README.md.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about behavior, the documentation is the authority:
change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit or delete
documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is the docstrings in `src/docx`,
including their examples, and the pages named above. In-package code comments are only supporting
evidence: when a comment conflicts with that documentation, follow the documentation. The design
notes under `docs/dev` are not part of the documentation.

Keep the public API stable and keep every behavior that already matches its documentation
working exactly as it does now.
